sector_model: cybersecurity software (foreign private issuer, US GAAP): P/E GAAP, EV/sales, FCF yield before and after SBC, net cash after convertible, deferred revenue
thesis: Check Point Software (Nasdaq: CHKP; Israel based, files 20-F/6-K, US GAAP USD) sells network security and subscriptions. Q3 2026 revenue 669.8M (-1% y/y); security subscriptions +11%, products and licenses -20% (105.5M vs 130.4M, unexplained in release); GAAP operating income 177.2M (-11%), GAAP EPS 1.82 vs 3.28 (Q3 2025 had about 1.47 tax settlement benefit); 9M OCF 881.0M vs 923.8M. TTM revenue 2,756.7M, GAAP NI 875.1M (excludes the Q3 2025 tax benefit), FCF 1,126.5M, SBC 226.9M. Cash and securities 4,122.9M vs 1,976.3M convertible notes (net cash about 2,147M). At 147.49 (2026-11-12 close; 52-week range 112.23-205.81): market cap about 15.06B on 102.10M shares (aggregator; period-end count not in release), EV about 12.9B, 4.7x TTM sales, 17.2x TTM GAAP earnings, FCF yield 7.5% (6.0% after SBC). Cheap on cash flow versus most software, but revenue is flat to down, margins are slipping and buybacks (975M in 9M26) are funded partly by new convertible debt.
counterthesis: The low multiple may be fair: total revenue is shrinking, GAAP operating margin fell from 30.2% to 27.2% (9M), hardware refresh product revenue fell 20% in Q3 and management only expects gradual improvement beginning in Q4 with no numeric guidance. SBC is high (about 8% of revenue). A 2B convertible with capped calls was issued while buying back about 975M of stock: this is leverage-assisted EPS support, and conversion terms (price, maturity, coupon) are unread. The 31% drop from the 52-week high is not evidence of cheapness. Israel geopolitical risk, security-platform competition (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Zscaler) and cash held partly in long-term marketable securities (1,969M) also matter. Peers, 20-F and convertible indenture unread.
invalidation: Thesis weakens if subscriptions growth falls below high single digits, total revenue declines again in Q4 and Q1, or operating margin falls below 25%. Valuation case needs sustained FCF yield above 6% after SBC with revenue stabilizing.
